$Comment: The top rung of the Headless Horseman's ladder: bring him down fifty times during one season.
The description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount.
Rewards.Auto pays what lands the moment it is earned: the title Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Bane (the
Title reward kind). Every year's copy names the same title, so a second year unlocks nothing new.
Rewards.Claim waits on the achievements page until the player collects it: favor with the
Hallowed, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, whose own Requires (the hytale:mod_installed gate)
leaves it out on a server without that mod.
